errors.text_span: и остава на този ниво до 2016 г., когато достига минимум от 0,00%
errors.evidence: This statement contains two errors. First, the value does not remain at the 2015 level until 2016; it drops from approximately 0.25% to approximately 0.1%. Second, the value in 2016 is not 0.00% and it is not the minimum for the period; the actual minimum of 0.00% occurs in 2013.
The word 'сплошна' is a typo. The correct Bulgarian word for 'solid' in this context is 'плътна'.
